description: Connects a custom domain or subdomain to a blog hosted by Outrank. The subdomain group adds a CNAME and an ownership TXT record, the apex group adds an A record and an ownership TXT record, and the optional vercel-verification group adds the TXT record Vercel asks for when the domain is already used on another Vercel account.
variableDescription: %subdomain%: the blog subdomain inside the zone, for example blog. %cname%: the Vercel CNAME target Outrank shows for the subdomain. %ip%: the Vercel IPv4 address Outrank shows for a root domain. %ownershiptoken%: the ownership token Outrank generated for this domain. %vercelverification%: the Vercel verification value, without the vc-domain-verify= prefix.
